```{r}
incels <- fread(
  "~/Downloads/incels.is_AllComments.anon",
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r}
setnames(
  incels,
  old = "924978982.463397",
  new = "user"
)
```

```{r}
incel_clean <- incels[
  !is.na(text) & trimws(text) != ""
]
```


```{r}
# Inspect the dataset
glimpse(incel_clean)

# Check the number of rows and columns
dim(incel_clean)

# See the column names
names(incel_clean)

# Preview the first few rows
head(incel_clean, 5)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Create a date variable from the Unix timestamp
incel_clean <- incel_clean %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.POSIXct(timestamp, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")),
    month = floor_date(date, unit = "month")
  )

# Check the date range
range(incel_clean$date, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check the number of comments per month
incel_clean %>%
  count(month, sort = FALSE) %>%
  print(n = 20)
```
```{r}
# Define the new set of lexicon terms
lexicon_terms <- c(
  "Chad" = "\\bchad\\b",
  "Cuck" = "\\bcuck\\b",
  "Truecel" = "\\btruecel\\b",
  "LDAR" = "\\bldar\\b",
  "Betabuxx" = "\\bbetabuxx\\b",
  "Mogger" = "\\bmogger\\b"
)

# Count total comments per month
monthly_totals <- incel_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
  count(month, name = "Total_Comments")

# Count comments containing each term by month
term_trends <- map_dfr(names(lexicon_terms), function(term) {

  pattern <- lexicon_terms[[term]]

  incel_clean %>%
    filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
    group_by(month) %>%
    summarise(
      Term_Count = sum(
        str_detect(
          coalesce(text, ""),
          regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Term = term)
})

# Calculate the percentage of comments containing each term
term_trends <- term_trends %>%
  left_join(monthly_totals, by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Term_Count / Total_Comments * 100
  )

# Set the order of the terms in the legend
term_trends$Term <- factor(
  term_trends$Term,
  levels = names(lexicon_terms)
)

# Create the visualization
ggplot(
  term_trends,
  aes(
    x = month,
    y = Percentage,
    color = Term
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "The Evolution of Incel Language, 2017–2023",
    subtitle = "Monthly percentage of comments containing selected lexicon terms",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Comments Containing Term (%)",
    color = "Lexicon Term",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: Incels.is comment dataset and Appendix A: Incel Lexicon.",
      "Each line represents the percentage of monthly comments containing a term."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
